assets.title: Intracranial microanatomy teaching-set review assembly
assets.description: Review-only gallery of all eleven scale-separated microanatomy vignettes; use individual packages at runtime.

warnings: Every package is a magnified, scale-separated vignette and must display a prominent not-to-anatomical-scale label.
No package is registered to the metre-scale head; never overlay it as if cell dimensions or placement were anatomical.
Geometry, spacing, thickness, counts, colors, flow cues, channel locations, tissue zones, and composition are illustrative and non-quantitative.
Image-generated maps are project-owned appearance references only and are not microscopy, histology, anatomy, pathology, or clinical evidence.
Do not use for diagnosis, treatment planning, navigation, device selection, perfusion assessment, pathology classification, prognosis, or outcome prediction.
Specialist neuroanatomy, neuropathology, hematology, neuroradiology, accessibility, and patient-communications review are required before patient-facing use.

prohibited_combinations.reason: Review assembly duplicates every individual vignette.
